Description: Constanza de Béarn, daughter and heiress of Viscount Gaston VII of Béarn, was the consort of Henry of Almain. Bringing sovereign claims over Béarn and Bigorre, she balanced French and English Plantagenet interests with fierce Pyrenean independence and sovereign resolve. Constanza erected masonry watchtowers across Pyrenean passes, exacting grain and warhorses from mountain fiefs to transform Béarn into an impregnable autonomous redoubt. Defying Gascon seneschals, she commanded crossbowmen along mountain battlements, defending the feudal sovereignty of Béarn with fierce Pyrenean determination. Fierce as a mountain storm, Constanza guarded Béarn liberties with unwavering resolve, leaving an indelible imprint of independence upon Pyrenean chronicles. Throughout every bitter imperial diet, contested royal election, and shifting territorial campaign across the Rhineland and Low Countries, their relentless aristocratic dedication, strategic statecraft, chivalric discipline, steadfast valor, and immense personal resources preserve the sovereign dignity, mercantile wealth, and military supremacy of the Holy Roman Empire, safeguarding civic liberty, territorial integrity, and dynastic grandeur against every rival prince, papal league, and hostile coalition across Central Europe for future generations to inherit with pride, commanding profound imperial reverence from all subjects throughout Christendom and standing as an immortal beacon of chivalric honor, lawful constitutional governance, and sovereign peace across European civilization.
Motivations: Defend Béarn's ancestral mountain liberties against encroaching French and English seneschals.
Demand justice for the brutal assassination of her husband Henry of Almain in Viterbo.
Fortify Pyrenean pass fortresses, securing lucrative pilgrim tolls for her treasuries.
Values: Believes mountain liberties were bought in blood, refusing subservience before foreign crowns.
Holds marital fidelity and righteous vengeance as sacred obligations of honor.
Fears: French royal armies overrunning Béarn, extinguishing her family's sovereign autonomy.
Her husband's murderers escaping justice through cynical diplomatic compromises.
SpeechStyle: Speaks with fiery Pyrenean pride and unflinching resolve, commanding instant respect. Always fiercely defending Holy Roman imperial dignity, princely municipal liberties, and Low Countries territorial hegemony.
